feeds.title: AGS Magazine
feeds.description: The Association of Geotechnical and Geoenvironmental Specialists (AGS) is a not-for-profit trade association established to improve the profile and quality of geotechnical and geoenvironmental engineering. Our mission is to promote and enhance the quality of professional practice in geotechnical and geoenvironmental engineering. Read our magazine to stay updated, we publish it monthly.

feeds.title: Earth Environmental & Geotechnical
feeds.description: Earth Environmental provides survey, assessment, and monitoring services to its clients. We provide a high-quality, cost-effective, and pragmatic geotechnical, mining, geological, and environmental service to our clients. Catch up with the latest News on geotechnical civil engineering, mining, engineering and construction, geotechnical mining, and geological & environmental service.

feeds.title: Ground Engineering Plus
feeds.description: Ground Engineering (GE) magazine provides information, news, and features on all new and practical aspects of geotechnics, geology, geo-environmental engineering, geotechnics, engineering geology, and geo-environmental engineering.

feeds.title: Offshore Engineer » Geotechnical
feeds.description: Offshore Engineer focuses heavily on new and proven technology and how it's being used or modified to overcome water depth obstacles and other regional or environmental concerns. We keep you posted about geotechnical developments through our publications.

feeds.title: Vulcan Hammer
feeds.description: Vulcan Hammer is a comprehensive resource for geotechnical and marine engineers, contractors, owners, and equipment specialists. The blog page is loaded with geotechnical engineering resources and educational materials.

feeds.title: Alpha-Omega Geotech Blog
feeds.description: Alpha-Omega Geotech is a seasoned group of geotechnical and civil engineers with extensive local knowledge of ground conditions. We partner with civil and structural engineers, architects, general contractors, municipalities, and private enterprises to ensure the stability of structures built on public and private land. Our blog will quench your thirst for new data in the field of geo-technology.

feeds.title: Measurand Blog
feeds.description: Measurand designs and manufactures ShapeArray, which is used to monitor the deformation of soil and structures like dams, tunnels, walls, and buildings. ShapeArray is an automated shape-measuring, inclinometer-style instrument on a reel, which has set a new standard for ease of installation. Your go-to resource for the latest geotechnical news thought leadership and company announcements. Check back often for ShapeArray product updates.

feeds.title: Geotill Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Geotill, we specialize in Geotechnical Engineering, Materials Engineering, Construction Testing and Subsurface Exploration. We routinely provide geotechnical evaluations, site exploration, and materials testing and consulting to small and large construction, engineering, architectural, retail, and development firms, as well as local governmental agencies. To know more on these topics, visit our blog.

feeds.title: High Plains Engineering & Consulting Blog
feeds.description: High Plains Engineering & Consulting's vision is to provide the best engineering services to improve the quality of life in our region. In High Plains Engineering & Consulting Blog we post about the latest developments and finding in the geotechnical field. If you would like more information about us, take a few minutes and check us out.

feeds.title: Kurloo Blog
feeds.description: Kurloo detects movement in buildings, built structures, and ground surfaces. Combining GNSS, IoT, and cloud computing, Kurloo helps you manage risk more easily and economically than ever before. Kurloo is an end-to-end, automated surface displacement monitoring service like no other.

feeds.title: Factor Geotechnical Blog
feeds.description: Factor Geotechnical strives to provide services tailored to your unique needs and projects. We bring modern business practices to geotechnical engineering. In our blog, named Factor Geotechnical Blog we answer common questions, teach young engineers, share our thoughts, and explore the Alberta construction industry.

feeds.title: Roseke Engineering Blog
feeds.description: Roseke Engineering's mission is to provide quality, timely, and cost-competitive engineering services. Our specialty is bridges, culverts, and drainage structures. We maintain a blog to share information about engineering structures and how to build them. Check out our blog to know more.

feeds.title: AES » Geotechnical Engineering
feeds.description: AES provides soil engineering, engineering geologic and environmental services, like a soils engineering report, for hundreds of construction projects every year across Southern California. Our blog contains information on geology and geotechnical data and new developments in the field.

feeds.title: Geotech Blog
feeds.description: GEO5 is among the leading developers of civil engineering software worldwide. We design and sell software for static analysis, dimensioning, and geotechnical engineering since 1989. To know more about the Finite element method or geotechnical events and news follow our blog.

feeds.title: Atlas Geotechnical Blog
feeds.description: Atlas Geotechnical delivers exceptional engineering solutions worldwide. Combining modern tools with time-honored rigor allows us to tackle challenges that confound conventional engineers.

feeds.title: Geocomp Blog
feeds.description: Geocomp Blog provides services and products to help clients identify and manage risk associated with the design, construction and operation of infrastructure.
